messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout: service `inference-api` -> v2.5.0-nightly at 12% (us-west, us-east). Change: tokenizer hotfix + KV prefetch throttle. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% or p95 > 360ms over 4m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-06/v2.5.0
marta: rolling. running canary-evals and smoke checks. quiet window starts 00:30 UTC; keep cautious.
eli: excl. heavy-embed tenants and analytics orgs. will watch output diffs.
noah: 2m in: us-west p95 ~210ms, us-east p95 ~220ms, 5xx 0.15%. looks fine so far.
ops-bot: FYI: scheduled backup job `user-data-snapshot` starts in us-east in ~6m, might affect IO on tokenizer nodes. tagging @infra.
infra: noted. that backup usually spikes disk/io on cache nodes for ~8-12m. recommend hold before any additional ramp in us-east.
marta: thanks. pausing any increases. quick vote: GO to proceed as planned, HOLD to pause/evaluate.
eli: HOLD for us-east, keep us-west continuing.
noah: HOLD for us-east. we can still monitor us-west at 12%.
deploy-bot: Action: split wave - us-west remains 12% on v2.5.0-nightly; us-east pinned to v2.4.8 until backup completes. Command executed: `pin-version --service inference-api --region us-east --version v2.4.8`
ops-bot: pin recorded (audit id 77521). us-east traffic pinned.
qa-bot: Running extended canary tests in us-west for 15m. suite: canary-output-diff, perf-smoke, long-tail-sampler.
noah: 4m in: us-west stable. us-east pinned back to v2.4.8. backup started; io spike observed on cache hosts (us-east-1a).
infra: backup causing cache eviction storms in us-east. good call to pin. no regression in us-west.
marta: propose to hold global ramp until backup completes and then re-evaluate. set watch for 20m post-backup.
eli: +1. also add a temporary fast-fail rule: if tokenization-timeout > 0.5% cancel any ramp.
deploy-bot: Rule updated: fast-fail tokenization-timeout > 0.5% over 3m -> auto-hold.
qa-bot: canary tests continuing in us-west. 8m: p95 225ms, diffs minimal.
noah: timeline: backup shows signs of tailing off in 10m. if stable, we can unpin and increment to 25% in us-west then cautiously to us-east.
ops-bot: Suggested command for unpin after backup: `unpin-version --service inference-api --region us-east` (requires two approvers).
marta: i'll approve first. tagging @eli for second approval when backup completes.
infra: backup finished. io normalized in us-east. verifying caches warmed.
eli: verified from logs. unpin approved. eli approves.
deploy-bot: Unpin executed: us-east removed pin. Current traffic: us-west 12% v2.5.0-nightly, us-east 0% -> pending shift.
marta: recommend staggered shift: us-east +8% -> 8% total, then +~7% after 10m if healthy. votes: GO to unpin+gradual shift, HOLD to re-run extended canary.
noah: GO for +8% now to ease ramp.
eli: GO but watch tokenization-timeouts closely.
deploy-bot: Initiating gradual shift: us-east 0% -> 8% (zone-staggered). Will post completion.
deploy-bot: Shift complete. us-east now at 8% for v2.5.0-nightly. Observability: https://dashboards/release/1745559999
noah: immediate check: us-east p95 spiked to 390ms for a minute, tokenization-timeouts at 0.45% (below fast-fail). stabilizing now to ~230ms.
ops-bot: note: fast-fail threshold still 0.5%. we are under. continue watch 10m.
qa-bot: running output-diff checks on us-east sample set; no functional regressions so far.
marta: decision: hold at current percentages for 15m. if p95 stays <350ms and tokenization-timeout <0.5% we proceed to 25% across regions. otherwise rollback plan ready: `deploy rollback inference-api --to v2.4.8 --regions us-east`
eli: ack. logging thread for post-release notes addendum about backup overlap and pin.
deploy-bot: Hold placed. Rollout paused at us-west 12%, us-east 8% pending 15m watch. Audit log: https://deploys/release/1745559999/audit
marta: thanks team. reconvene in 15m or sooner if alerts. :coffee:
